title: The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet
author: Becky Chambers
summary: A young woman with a secret past joins the crew of a patched-up ship that builds tunnels through space. On a long trip to a distant planet she gets to know the unusual crew, who become her family.
readIf: you want a gentle, character-first space story about friendship and kindness.
skipIf: you want a tight plot or high stakes, because the story is episodic and often relaxed.

pairings.reason: The same author's shorter, quieter and equally warm story about caring and connection.
Another ship full of misfits drifting through space, with much sillier humour.
A cosy fantasy about outsiders making a family, with the same big-hearted feel.
